title: Module 2: Applying Ethics Frameworks to AI
description: Triangulate AI deployment decisions across consequentialism, deontology, virtue ethics, and care ethics; recognize where the frameworks converge (permission to proceed) and where they diverge (the live decision).

learning_objectives.statement: Apply each of four ethical frameworks (consequentialist, deontological, virtue, care) to a deployment decision
Identify each framework's diagnostic question, strengths, and characteristic blind spots
Distinguish convergence (defensible) from disagreement (where the live ethical choice lives)
Reject the move of hiding a contested decision behind any single framework's verdict

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
